governing_principle: Verified cash from pre-existing buyer demand outranks invented offers, startup creation, internal architecture, feature count, opportunity scores, and speculative market narratives.

primary_experiment.name: Marketplace-first paid technical operator work
primary_experiment.thesis: Do not invent a business before demand. Pursue only buyer-posted work where the buyer has already stated the problem, budget, and intent to hire.
target_roles: small bounded automation or internal-tool work using tools already demonstrated
disallowed_positioning: senior software engineer unless the scope can be truthfully supported by demonstrated experience
AWS/GCP infrastructure expert without prior demonstrated delivery
n8n/Make/Zapier expert unless prior hands-on proof exists
any role requiring fabricated years of experience, fabricated clients, fabricated revenue impact, or fabricated case studies
primary_experiment.acquisition_spend_note: Do not purchase subscriptions, ads, boosts, domains, hosting, or build credits for this experiment. A one-time marketplace proposal-token test may spend no more than $15 with owner approval.
primary_experiment.application_rule: Apply only where at least 70% of the requested work maps to existing demonstrated capability and every claimed example can be shown.
primary_experiment.portfolio_rule: Use existing public repositories, live sites, CI evidence, and truthful screen recordings. Do not build speculative portfolio projects before applying.
primary_experiment.failure_rule: After the first bounded batch of high-fit applications, if there are no substantive buyer responses, inspect positioning and target fit before spending more. No new product build is an allowed response to failed applications.

resource_rules: Research may identify fresh buyer-posted opportunities and required application language only.
Engineering capacity stays idle until it supports a real application proof gap that can be closed cheaply or a funded customer contract.
Do not build a new SaaS, marketplace, diagnostic product, dashboard, agent hierarchy, recovery vertical, brand, payment page, or marketing site merely to create activity.
Do not use paid model/work credits to simulate customer work before a contract exists.
Existing portfolio projects are evidence assets, not presumed businesses.
